Rules.InvariantScript:
UpdateContext({locSelectedRecordTypeAddPeriod: Blank()});
Switch(
    Self.Selected.ItemKey,
    "newOpexProjectCostType",
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locSelectedSubaccount: ThisItem,
            locSelectedOpexCostParent: Blank(),
            locSelectedOpexCost: Blank(),
            locIsVisibleRightPanelNewEditOpexCost: true,
            locSelectedProjectCosts: Filter(
                colOpexProjectCosts,
                Subaccount.'Opex Subaccount' = ThisItem.'Opex Subaccount'
            ),
            locSelectedOpexCostNext: Blank(),
            locCODDate: gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
            locSelectedDevice: ThisItem.Name,
            locResetStartDate: true
        }
    );
    UpdateContext({locIsStartDateStandardAssumption: 'IsStartDateStandardAssumption (Opex Project Costs)'.No}),
    "newOpexProjectCost",
    With(
        {
            varSelectedOpexCost: locSelectedOpexCost,
            varSelectedSubaccount: gal_OpexCosts_Content_Subaccounts.Selected
        },
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locSelectedSubaccount: varSelectedSubaccount,
                locIsVisibleRightPanelNewEditOpexCost: true,
                //locSelectedOpexCostParent: locSelectedOpexCost,
                locSelectedOpexCostParent: Coalesce(
                    LookUp(
                        colOpexProjectCosts,
                        'Opex Project Cost' = locSelectedOpexCost.'Parent Cost'.'Opex Project Cost'
                    ),
                    locSelectedOpexCost
                ),
                locSelectedOpexCostNext: locSelectedOpexCost,
                locSelectedOpexCost: Blank(),
                locSelectedProjectCosts: Filter(
                    colOpexProjectCosts,
                    Subaccount.'Opex Subaccount' = varSelectedSubaccount.'Opex Subaccount'
                )
            }
        )
    );
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locCODDate: gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
            locResetStartDate: IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCostNext)
        }
    ),
    "newAddStandardContractKey",
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: true,
            locSpinnerInformationText: "Please wait, loading Standard Assumption Contract..."
        }
    );
    Clear(colOtherOpexPeriods);
    Clear(colOtherOpexStandardAssumptionContract);
    With(
        {
            recFilteredStandardContractsForProject: Filter(
                'Opex Project Costs',
                And(
                    Project.Project = gblSelectedProject.Project,
                    'Is Standard Contract?' = 'Is Standard Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                    Subaccount.'Opex Subaccount' = ThisItem.'Opex Subaccount'
                )
            ),
            recCountryTechnologyRelatedStandardAssumption: Sort(
                Filter(
                    'OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions',
                    And(
                        Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                        Technology = gblSelectedProject.Technology,
                        'Type Of Contract' = 'Contract Types'.'Opex Other',
                        'Opex Subaccount'.'Opex Subaccount' = ThisItem.'Opex Subaccount'
                    )
                ),
                Description,
                SortOrder.Ascending
            ),
            recCODDate: gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
            recCODYear: Year(gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)') + 1
        },
        If(
            CountRows(recFilteredStandardContractsForProject) = 0,
            With(
                {
                    recSortedCountryTechnologyStandardAssumptions: recCountryTechnologyRelatedStandardAssumption,
                    recStandardAssumptionContracts: Filter(
                        recCountryTechnologyRelatedStandardAssumption,
                        And(Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1')
                    )
                },
                ForAll(
                    recStandardAssumptionContracts,
                    With(
                        {StandardAssumptionContractRecord: ThisRecord},
                        Collect(
                            colOtherOpexStandardAssumptionContract,
                            Patch(
                                'Opex Project Costs',
                                Defaults('Opex Project Costs'),
                                {
                                    Project: gblSelectedProject,
                                    Subaccount: StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Opex Subaccount',
                                    DeviceTypeInProject: Blank(),
                                    Name: "Other OPEX Costs" & "-" & StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Opex Subaccount'.Name & "-" & StandardAssumptionContractRecord.Description,
                                    Description: Trim(StandardAssumptionContractRecord.Description),
                                    'Start Date': recCODDate,
                                    'Opex Project duration years': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Duration In Years',
                                    'Opex Project duration months': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Duration in Months',
                                    Currency: StandardAssumptionContractRecord.Currency,
                                    'Fix Costs': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Fix Costs',
                                    '% of Revenues': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'% of Revenues',
                                    Threshold: If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Threshold?' = 'Threshold? (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'Threshold (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'Threshold (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    ),
                                    'Threshold Type': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Threshold Type',
                                    'Threshold individual': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Threshold Individual',
                                    'EUR/MWh': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'EUR/MWh',
                                    'EUR/MW': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'EUR/MW',
                                    'EUR/WTG': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'EUR/WTG',
                                    Aggregation: StandardAssumptionContractRecord.Aggregation,
                                    'Parent Cost': Blank(),
                                    'Use Inflation Profile': If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    ),
                                    'Use Country Inflation Profile': If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    ),
                                    'Inflation Profile': Switch(
                                        true,
                                        And(
                                            StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                            StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes
                                        ),
                                        LookUp(
                                            'Country Inflation Profiles',
                                            Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country && Year = recCODYear
                                        ).Inflation,
                                        And(
                                            StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                            StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.No
                                        ),
                                        StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Inflation Profile',
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    'Inflation Start Year': recCODYear,
                                    'Inflation Country Area': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Inflation Country Area',
                                    'Distribution Frequency': StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Distribution Frequency',
                                    'Owning Business Unit': gblSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)',
                                    'Align With Project Duration': If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'Align with Project Duration' = 'Align with Project Duration (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    ),
                                    IsStartDateStandardAssumption: 'IsStartDateStandardAssumption (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                    'Is Standard Contract?': 'Is Standard Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                    'External Contract?': If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContractRecord.'External Contract?' = 'External Contract? (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    )
                                }
                            )
                        )
                    )
                );
                ForAll(
                    Filter(
                        recSortedCountryTechnologyStandardAssumptions,
                        Not(Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1')
                    ),
                    With(
                        {
                            recStandardAssumptionRecord: ThisRecord,
                            recSubAccountID: ThisRecord.'Opex Subaccount'.'Opex Subaccount'
                        },
                        If(
                            recStandardAssumptionRecord.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
                            RemoveIf(
                                colOtherOpexPeriods,
                                true
                            )
                        );
                        With(
                            {
                                recProjectCost: LookUp(
                                    colOtherOpexStandardAssumptionContract,
                                    And(Subaccount.'Opex Subaccount' = recSubAccountID)
                                )
                            },
                            With(
                                {
                                    recStartDate: Switch(
                                        recStandardAssumptionRecord.Period,
                                        'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
                                        recCODDate,
                                        'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 2',
                                        DateAdd(
                                            recProjectCost.'Start Date',
                                            Value(recProjectCost.'Opex Project duration years') * 12 + Value(recProjectCost.'Opex Project duration months'),
                                            TimeUnit.Months
                                        ),
                                        DateAdd(
                                            Last(
                                                Sort(
                                                    colOtherOpexPeriods,
                                                    Period,
                                                    SortOrder.Ascending
                                                )
                                            ).'Start Date',
                                            Value(
                                                Last(
                                                    Sort(
                                                        colOtherOpexPeriods,
                                                        Period,
                                                        SortOrder.Ascending
                                                    )
                                                ).'Opex Project duration years'
                                            ) * 12 + Value(
                                                Last(
                                                    Sort(
                                                        colOtherOpexPeriods,
                                                        Period,
                                                        SortOrder.Ascending
                                                    )
                                                ).'Opex Project duration months'
                                            ),
                                            TimeUnit.Months
                                        )
                                    )
                                },
                                Collect(
                                    colOtherOpexPeriods,
                                    Patch(
                                        'Opex Project Costs',
                                        Defaults('Opex Project Costs'),
                                        {
                                            Project: gblSelectedProject,
                                            Subaccount: recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Opex Subaccount',
                                            DeviceTypeInProject: Blank(),
                                            Name: "Other OPEX Costs" & "-" & recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Opex Subaccount'.Name & "-" & recStandardAssumptionRecord.Description,
                                            Description: Trim(recStandardAssumptionRecord.Description),
                                            'Start Date': recStartDate,
                                            'Opex Project duration years': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Duration In Years',
                                            'Opex Project duration months': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Duration in Months',
                                            Currency: recStandardAssumptionRecord.Currency,
                                            'Fix Costs': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Fix Costs',
                                            '% of Revenues': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'% of Revenues',
                                            Threshold: If(
                                                recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Threshold?' = 'Threshold? (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                'Threshold (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                'Threshold (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                            ),
                                            'Threshold Type': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Threshold Type',
                                            'Threshold individual': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Threshold Individual',
                                            'EUR/MWh': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'EUR/MWh',
                                            'EUR/MW': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'EUR/MW',
                                            'EUR/WTG': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'EUR/WTG',
                                            Aggregation: recStandardAssumptionRecord.Aggregation,
                                            'Parent Cost': recProjectCost,
                                            'Use Inflation Profile': If(
                                                recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                'Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                'Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                            ),
                                            'Use Country Inflation Profile': If(
                                                recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                'Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                'Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                            ),
                                            'Inflation Profile': Switch(
                                                true,
                                                And(
                                                    recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                    recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes
                                                ),
                                                LookUp(
                                                    'Country Inflation Profiles',
                                                    Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country && Year = recCODYear
                                                ).Inflation,
                                                And(
                                                    recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                    recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.No
                                                ),
                                                recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Inflation Profile',
                                                Blank()
                                            ),
                                            'Inflation Start Year': recCODYear,
                                            'Inflation Country Area': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Inflation Country Area',
                                            'Distribution Frequency': recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Distribution Frequency',
                                            'Owning Business Unit': gblSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)',
                                            'Align With Project Duration': If(
                                                recStandardAssumptionRecord.'Align with Project Duration' = 'Align with Project Duration (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                            ),
                                            IsStartDateStandardAssumption: 'IsStartDateStandardAssumption (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                            'Is Standard Contract?': 'Is Standard Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                            'External Contract?': If(
                                                recStandardAssumptionRecord.'External Contract?' = 'External Contract? (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                            )
                                        }
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    );
    ClearCollect(
        colOpexProjectCosts,
        Filter(
            'Opex Project Costs',
            Project.Project = gblSelectedProject.Project
        )
    );
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: false,
            locSpinnerInformationText: ""
        }
    );
    ,
    "editOpexProjectCost",
    With(
        {
            varSelectedOpexCost: locSelectedOpexCost,
            varSelectedOpexCostParent: LookUp(
                colOpexProjectCosts,
                'Opex Project Cost' = locSelectedOpexCost.'Parent Cost'.'Opex Project Cost'

        },
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locSelectedSubaccount: gal_OpexCosts_Content_Subaccounts.Selected,
                locSelectedOpexCost: Blank(),
                locSelectedOpexCostParent: varSelectedOpexCostParent,
                locIsStartDateStandardAssumption: If(
                    IsBlank(varSelectedOpexCost.'Parent Cost'),
                    varSelectedOpexCost.IsStartDateStandardAssumption,
                    'IsStartDateStandardAssumption (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                )
            }
        );
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locSelectedOpexCost: varSelectedOpexCost,
                locIsVisibleRightPanelNewEditOpexCost: true
            }
        )
    );
    UpdateContext({locCODDate: locSelectedOpexCost.'Start Date'}),
    "deleteOpexProjectCost",
    UpdateContext({locIsVisiblePopUpDeleteOpexCosts: true})
);
Reset(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Currency);
Reset(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Aggregation);
Reset(togl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Threshold);
Reset(rdg_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Threshold);
Reset(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Threshold_Individual);
Reset(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DurationYears);
Reset(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DurationMonths);
Reset(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DistributionFrequency_Month);
//Reset(tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AlignWithProjectDuration);

$"Fix Costs p.a. [{If(
    Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')),
    gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code',
    "EUR"
)}]"
$"{If(Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')), gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code', "Cur.")}/MWh p.a."
$"{If(Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')), gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code', "Cur.")}/MW p.a."
$"{If(Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')), gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code', "Cur.")}/WTG p.a."

Sort(
    Sort(
        Filter(
            colOpexProjectCosts,
            Subaccount.'Opex Subaccount' = ThisItem.'Opex Subaccount'
        ),
        'Start Date',
        SortOrder.Ascending
    ),
    Description,
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

If(
    Not(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Opex Project duration years')),
    $"{ThisItem.'Opex Project duration years'} years"
)

If(
    Not(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Opex Project duration months')),
    $"{ThisItem.'Opex Project duration months'} months"
)

Text(
    DateAdd(
        DateAdd(
            ThisItem.'Start Date',
            ThisItem.'Opex Project duration years' * 12 + ThisItem.'Opex Project duration months',
            TimeUnit.Months
        ),
        -1,
        TimeUnit.Days
    ),
    "dd.mm.yy"
)

If(
    And(
        ThisItem.'Use Country Inflation Profile'='Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
        ThisItem.'Use Inflation Profile'='Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes
    ),
    If(
        gblSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Italy",
        "Italy - " & Substitute(
            gblAreaWithRegion,
            "Italy_",
            ""
        ),
        gblSelectedProject.Country.Name
    ),
    Text(
        ThisItem.'Inflation Profile',
        "###,###,###.0 %"
    )
)

If(
    ThisItem.Threshold,
    Switch(
        ThisItem.'Threshold Type',
        Thresholds.'Net Yield p75',
        "p75",
        Thresholds.'Net Yield p90',
        "p90",
        Text(
            ThisItem.'Threshold individual',
            "###,###.0"
        )
    ),
    Blank()
)

/*With(
    {

                CostRow.'Align With Project Duration' = 'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.No
            )
        ),
        varCostsForDurationAligned: CountRows(
            Filter(
                colOpexProjectCosts As CostRow,

                ) = gblSelectedProject.'End Date',
                CostRow.'Align With Project Duration' = 'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes
            )
        ),
        varCostsForNotDurationAligned: CountRows(
            Filter(
                colOpexProjectCosts As CostRow,
                CostRow.DeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject = ThisItem.DeviceTypesInProject,
                CostRow.'Start Date' >= gblSelectedProject.'Project Start Date',
                DateAdd(
                    DateAdd(
                        CostRow.'Start Date',
                        CostRow.'Opex Project duration years' * 12 + CostRow.'Opex Project duration months',
                        TimeUnit.Months
                    ),
                    -1,
                    TimeUnit.Days
                //) < gblSelectedProject.'End Date',
                ) = gblSelectedProject.'End Date',
                CostRow.'Align With Project Duration' = 'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.No
            )
        )
    },
    With(
        {
            locCostsForNotDurationAligned: locCostNotAlignedDurationCount - varCostsForNotDurationAligned,
            locCostsForDurationAligned: locCostAlignedDurationCount - varCostsForDurationAligned
        },
        If(
            // NEw Line
            locTotal = 0,
            Color.Transparent,
            locCostAlignedDurationCount = 0 && locCostNotAlignedDurationCount = 0,
            Color.Transparent,
            locCostAlignedDurationCount > 0 && locCostsForDurationAligned = 0 && locCostNotAlignedDurationCount = 0,
            ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.SuccessLight),
            locCostAlignedDurationCount > 0 && locCostsForDurationAligned > 0 && locCostNotAlignedDurationCount = 0,
            ColorFade(
                ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.Warning),
                60%
            ),
            locCostAlignedDurationCount = 0 && locCostNotAlignedDurationCount > 0 && locCostsForNotDurationAligned > 0,
            Color.Transparent,
            locCostAlignedDurationCount = 0 && locCostNotAlignedDurationCount > 0 && locCostsForNotDurationAligned = 0,
            ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.SuccessLight),
            locCostAlignedDurationCount > 0 && locCostsForDurationAligned = 0 && locCostNotAlignedDurationCount > 0 && locCostsForNotDurationAligned = 0,
            ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.SuccessLight),
            locCostAlignedDurationCount > 0 && locCostsForDurationAligned > 0,
            ColorFade(
                ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.Warning),
                60%
            ),
            locCostAlignedDurationCount > 0 && locCostsForDurationAligned = 0 && locCostNotAlignedDurationCount > 0 && locCostsForNotDurationAligned > 0,

            ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.SuccessLight)
        )
    )

Rules.InvariantScript:
UpdateContext(
    {
        locSelectedRecordTypeAddPeriod: If(
            Left(
                ThisItem.Name,
                3
            ) = "WTG",
            "Generator",
            "PVModule"
        ),
        locSelectedDevice: With(
            {
                varRecordPVModuleType: If(
                    IsType(
                        ThisItem.TypeInProject,
                        PVModuleTypeInProjects
                    ),
                    LookUp(
                        PVModuleTypeInProjects,
                        PVModuleTypeInProject = AsType(
                            ThisItem.TypeInProject,
                            PVModuleTypeInProjects
                        ).PVModuleTypeInProject
                    ),
                    Blank()
                )
            },
            If(
                IsType(
                    ThisItem.TypeInProject,
                    PVModuleTypeInProjects
                ),
                If(
                    Not(IsBlank(varRecordPVModuleType)),
                    varRecordPVModuleType.Label
                ),
                IsType(
                    ThisItem.TypeInProject,
                    GeneratorTypeInProjects
                ),
                LookUp(
                    GeneratorTypeInProjects,
                    GeneratorTypeInProject = AsType(
                        ThisItem.TypeInProject,
                        GeneratorTypeInProjects
                    ).GeneratorTypeInProject
                ).Generator.'Turbine Type'
            )
        ),
        locSelectedSubaccount: LookUp(
            colOpexSubaccounts,
            Account.'Opex Account' = First(colOpexAccounts).'Opex Account'
        )
    }
);
Switch(
    Self.Selected.ItemKey,
    "newOpexProjectCost",
    If(
        ThisItem.DeviceTypesInProject <> locSelectedDeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject,
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locSelectedOpexCostParent: Blank(),
                locSelectedOpexCostNext: Blank()
            }
        ),
        UpdateContext(
            {
                // locSelectedOpexCostParent: locSelectedOpexCost
                locSelectedOpexCostParent: Coalesce(
                    LookUp(
                        colOpexProjectCosts,
                        'Opex Project Cost' = locSelectedOpexCost.'Parent Cost'.'Opex Project Cost'
                    ),
                    locSelectedOpexCost
                ),
                locSelectedOpexCostNext: locSelectedOpexCost
            }
        )
    );
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locSelectedDeviceTypeInProject: ThisItem,
            locSelectedOpexCost: Blank(),
            locIsVisibleRightPanelNewEditOpexCost: true,
            locSelectedProjectCosts: Filter(
                colOpexProjectCosts,
                DeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject = ThisItem.DeviceTypesInProject
            ),
            locIsStartDateStandardAssumption: 'IsStartDateStandardAssumption (Opex Project Costs)'.No,
            locCODDate: gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
            locResetStartDate: IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCostNext)
        }
    ),
    "addStandardContract",
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: true,
            locSpinnerInformationText: "Please wait, loading Standard Assumption Contract..."
        }
    );
    Clear(colOperationAndMaintainanceStandardAssumptionPeriod);
    Clear(colOperationAndMaintainanceStandardAssumptionContract);
    With(
        {
            recFilteredStandardContractsForProject: Filter(
                'Opex Project Costs',
                And(
                    Project.Project = gblSelectedProject.Project,
                    'Is Standard Contract?' = 'Is Standard Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                    DeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject = ThisItem.DeviceTypesInProject
                )
            ),
            recCountryTechnologyRelatedStandardAssumption: Sort(
                Filter(
                    'OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions',
                    And(
                        Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                        Technology = gblSelectedProject.Technology,
                        'Type Of Contract' = 'Contract Types'.'Opex O&M'
                    )
                ),
                Description,
                SortOrder.Ascending
            ),
            recCODDate: gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
            recCODYear: Year(gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)') + 1
        },
        If(
            CountRows(recFilteredStandardContractsForProject) = 0,
            With(
                {
                    recSortedCountryTechnologyStandardAssumptions: recCountryTechnologyRelatedStandardAssumption,
                    recStandardAssumptionContracts: Filter(
                        recCountryTechnologyRelatedStandardAssumption,
                        And(Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1')
                    ),
                    recSelectedDeviceType: Filter(
                        colDeviceTypesInProject,
                        DeviceTypesInProject = ThisItem.DeviceTypesInProject
                    )
                },
                ForAll(
                    recStandardAssumptionContracts As StandardAssumptionContract,
                    ForAll(
                        recSelectedDeviceType As DeviceTypeInProject,
                        Collect(
                            colOperationAndMaintainanceStandardAssumptionContract,
                            Patch(
                                'Opex Project Costs',
                                Defaults('Opex Project Costs'),
                                {
                                    Project: gblSelectedProject,
                                    Subaccount: locSelectedSubaccount,
                                    DeviceTypeInProject: DeviceTypeInProject,
                                    Name: "Operation & Maintenance" & "-" & locSelectedSubaccount.Name & "-" & StandardAssumptionContract.Description,
                                    Description: Trim(StandardAssumptionContract.Description),
                                    'Start Date': recCODDate,
                                    'Opex Project duration years': StandardAssumptionContract.'Duration In Years',
                                    'Opex Project duration months': StandardAssumptionContract.'Duration in Months',
                                    Currency: StandardAssumptionContract.Currency,
                                    'Fix Costs': StandardAssumptionContract.'Fix Costs',
                                    '% of Revenues': StandardAssumptionContract.'% of Revenues',
                                    Threshold: If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'Threshold?' = 'Threshold? (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'Threshold (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'Threshold (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    ),
                                    'Threshold Type': StandardAssumptionContract.'Threshold Type',
                                    'Threshold individual': StandardAssumptionContract.'Threshold Individual',
                                    'EUR/MWh': StandardAssumptionContract.'EUR/MWh',
                                    'EUR/MW': StandardAssumptionContract.'EUR/MW',
                                    'EUR/WTG': StandardAssumptionContract.'EUR/WTG',
                                    Aggregation: StandardAssumptionContract.Aggregation,
                                    'Parent Cost': Blank(),
                                    'Use Inflation Profile': If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    ),
                                    'Use Country Inflation Profile': If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    ),
                                    'Inflation Profile': Switch(
                                        true,
                                        And(
                                            StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                            StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes
                                        ),
                                        LookUp(
                                            'Country Inflation Profiles',
                                            Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country && Year = recCODYear
                                        ).Inflation,
                                        And(
                                            StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                            StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.No
                                        ),
                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'Inflation Profile',
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    'Inflation Start Year': recCODYear,
                                    'Inflation Country Area': StandardAssumptionContract.'Inflation Country Area',
                                    'Distribution Frequency': StandardAssumptionContract.'Distribution Frequency',
                                    'Owning Business Unit': gblSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)',
                                    'Align With Project Duration': If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'Align with Project Duration' = 'Align with Project Duration (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    ),
                                    IsStartDateStandardAssumption: 'IsStartDateStandardAssumption (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                    'Is Standard Contract?': 'Is Standard Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                    'External Contract?': If(
                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'External Contract?' = 'External Contract? (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                        'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                        'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                    )
                                }
                            )
                        )
                    )
                );
                ForAll(
                    recSelectedDeviceType As DeviceTypeInProject1,
                    RemoveIf(
                        colOperationAndMaintainanceStandardAssumptionPeriod,
                        true
                    );
                    ForAll(
                        recSortedCountryTechnologyStandardAssumptions As StandardAssumptionContract,
                        If(
                            StandardAssumptionContract.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
                            false,
                            With(
                                {
                                    recProjectCost: LookUp(
                                        colOperationAndMaintainanceStandardAssumptionContract,
                                        And(
                                            Subaccount.'Opex Subaccount' = locSelectedSubaccount.'Opex Subaccount',
                                            DeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject = DeviceTypeInProject1.DeviceTypesInProject
                                        )
                                    )
                                },
                                With(
                                    {
                                        recStartDate: Switch(
                                            StandardAssumptionContract.Period,
                                            'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
                                            recCODDate,
                                            'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 2',
                                            DateAdd(
                                                recProjectCost.'Start Date',
                                                Value(recProjectCost.'Opex Project duration years') * 12 + Value(recProjectCost.'Opex Project duration months'),
                                                TimeUnit.Months
                                            ),
                                            DateAdd(
                                                Last(
                                                    Sort(
                                                        colOperationAndMaintainanceStandardAssumptionPeriod,
                                                        Description,
                                                        SortOrder.Ascending
                                                    )
                                                ).'Start Date',
                                                Value(
                                                    Last(
                                                        Sort(
                                                            colOperationAndMaintainanceStandardAssumptionPeriod,
                                                            Description,
                                                            SortOrder.Ascending
                                                        )
                                                    ).'Opex Project duration years'
                                                ) * 12 + Value(
                                                    Last(
                                                        Sort(
                                                            colOperationAndMaintainanceStandardAssumptionPeriod,
                                                            Description,
                                                            SortOrder.Ascending
                                                        )
                                                    ).'Opex Project duration months'
                                                ),
                                                TimeUnit.Months
                                            )
                                        )
                                    },
                                    Collect(
                                        colOperationAndMaintainanceStandardAssumptionPeriod,
                                        Patch(
                                            'Opex Project Costs',
                                            Defaults('Opex Project Costs'),
                                            {
                                                Project: gblSelectedProject,
                                                Subaccount: locSelectedSubaccount,
                                                DeviceTypeInProject: DeviceTypeInProject1,
                                                Name: "Operation & Maintenance" & "-" & locSelectedSubaccount.Name & "-" & StandardAssumptionContract.Description,
                                                Description: Trim(StandardAssumptionContract.Description),
                                                'Start Date': recStartDate,
                                                'Opex Project duration years': StandardAssumptionContract.'Duration In Years',
                                                'Opex Project duration months': StandardAssumptionContract.'Duration in Months',
                                                Currency: StandardAssumptionContract.Currency,
                                                'Fix Costs': StandardAssumptionContract.'Fix Costs',
                                                '% of Revenues': StandardAssumptionContract.'% of Revenues',
                                                Threshold: If(
                                                    StandardAssumptionContract.'Threshold?' = 'Threshold? (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                    'Threshold (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                    'Threshold (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                                ),
                                                'Threshold Type': StandardAssumptionContract.'Threshold Type',
                                                'Threshold individual': StandardAssumptionContract.'Threshold Individual',
                                                'EUR/MWh': StandardAssumptionContract.'EUR/MWh',
                                                'EUR/MW': StandardAssumptionContract.'EUR/MW',
                                                'EUR/WTG': StandardAssumptionContract.'EUR/WTG',
                                                Aggregation: StandardAssumptionContract.Aggregation,
                                                'Parent Cost': recProjectCost,
                                                'Use Inflation Profile': If(
                                                    StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                    'Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                    'Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                                ),
                                                'Use Country Inflation Profile': If(
                                                    StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                    'Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                    'Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                                ),
                                                'Inflation Profile': Switch(
                                                    true,
                                                    And(
                                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes
                                                    ),
                                                    LookUp(
                                                        'Country Inflation Profiles',
                                                        Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country && Year = recCODYear
                                                    ).Inflation,
                                                    And(
                                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                        StandardAssumptionContract.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.No
                                                    ),
                                                    StandardAssumptionContract.'Inflation Profile',
                                                    Blank()
                                                ),
                                                'Inflation Start Year': recCODYear,
                                                'Inflation Country Area': StandardAssumptionContract.'Inflation Country Area',
                                                'Distribution Frequency': StandardAssumptionContract.'Distribution Frequency',
                                                'Owning Business Unit': gblSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)',
                                                'Align With Project Duration': If(
                                                    StandardAssumptionContract.'Align with Project Duration' = 'Align with Project Duration (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                    'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                    'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                                ),
                                                IsStartDateStandardAssumption: 'IsStartDateStandardAssumption (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                'Is Standard Contract?': 'Is Standard Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                'External Contract?': If(
                                                    StandardAssumptionContract.'External Contract?' = 'External Contract? (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
                                                    'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
                                                    'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                                                )
                                            }
                                        )
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    );
    Concurrent(
        Refresh('Opex Project Costs'),
        Refresh(DeviceTypesInProjects),
        Refresh(GeneratorInProjects)
    );
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locSelectedAccount: First(colOpexAccounts),
            locSelectedDeviceTypeInProject: Blank(),
            locSelectedOpexCost: Blank(),
            locSelectedOpexCostParent: Blank(),
            locIsVisibleRightPanelNewEditOpexCost: false,
            locIsVisiblePopUpDeleteOpexCosts: false,
            locSpinnerInformationText: "",
            locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: false,
            locCandidateOpexCostDesc: ""
        }
    );
    With(
        {
            varSelectedSubaccount: LookUp(
                colOpexSubaccounts,
                Account.'Opex Account' = locSelectedAccount.'Opex Account'
            )
        },
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locSelectedSubaccount: LookUp(
                    colOpexSubaccounts,
                    Account.'Opex Account' = locSelectedAccount.'Opex Account'
                ),
                locSelectedSubaccountOandM: If(
                    varSelectedSubaccount.Name = "Operation & Maintenance",
                    true,
                    false
                )
            }
        )
    );
    ClearCollect(
        colDeviceTypesInProject,
        AddColumns(
            Sort(
                AddColumns(
                    Filter(
                        DeviceTypesInProjects,
                        AsType(
                            TypeInProject,
                            GeneratorTypeInProjects
                        ).Project.Project = gblSelectedProject.Project
                    ) As DeviceItem,
                    CreatedOnGenerator,
                    LookUp(
                        GeneratorTypeInProjects,
                        And(
                            Project.Project = gblSelectedProject.Project,
                            Name = DeviceItem.Name
                        )
                    )
                ),
                CreatedOnGenerator.'Created On',
                SortOrder.Ascending
            ),
            IsFolded,
            true
        )
    );
    Collect(
        colDeviceTypesInProject,
        AddColumns(
            Filter(
                DeviceTypesInProjects,
                AsType(
                    TypeInProject,
                    PVModuleTypeInProjects
                ).Project.Project = gblSelectedProject.Project
            ),
            IsFolded,
            true
        )
    );
    ClearCollect(
        colOpexProjectCosts,
        Filter(
            'Opex Project Costs',
            Project.Project = gblSelectedProject.Project
        )
    );
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: false,
            locSpinnerInformationText: " "
        }
    );
    ,
    "editOpexProjectCost",
    With(
        {
            varSelectedOpexCost: locSelectedOpexCost,
            varSelectedDeviceTypeInProject: ThisItem,
            varSelectedOpexCostParent: LookUp(
                colOpexProjectCosts,
                'Opex Project Cost' = locSelectedOpexCost.'Parent Cost'.'Opex Project Cost'
            )
        },
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locSelectedDeviceTypeInProject: varSelectedDeviceTypeInProject,
                locSelectedOpexCost: Blank()
            }
        );
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locSelectedOpexCost: varSelectedOpexCost,
                locSelectedOpexCostParent: varSelectedOpexCostParent,
                locIsVisibleRightPanelNewEditOpexCost: true,
                locSelectedOpexCostNext: Blank(),
                locSelectedProjectCosts: Filter(
                    colOpexProjectCosts,
                    DeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject = varSelectedDeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject
                ),
                locCODDate: varSelectedOpexCost.'Start Date',
                locIsStartDateStandardAssumption: If(
                    IsBlank(varSelectedOpexCost.'Parent Cost'),
                    varSelectedOpexCost.IsStartDateStandardAssumption,
                    'IsStartDateStandardAssumption (Opex Project Costs)'.No
                )
            }
        );
    ),
    "deleteOpexProjectCost",
    UpdateContext({locIsVisiblePopUpDeleteOpexCosts: true})
);
Select(pcf_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyButtons_Reset);

$"Fix Costs p.a. [{If(
    Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')),
    gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code',
    "EUR"
)}]"
$"{If(Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')), gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code', "Cur.")}/MWh p.a."
$"{If(Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')), gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code', "Cur.")}/MW p.a."
$"{If(Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')), gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code', "Cur.")}/WTG p.a."
"Threshold for " & If(Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')), gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code', "EUR") & "/MWh p.a."

Sort(
    Sort(
        Filter(
            colOpexProjectCosts,
            DeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject = ThisItem.DeviceTypesInProject
        ),
        'Start Date',
        SortOrder.Ascending
    ),
    Description,
    SortOrder.Ascending
)
If(Not(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Opex Project duration years')), $"{ThisItem.'Opex Project duration years'} years")
If(Not(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Opex Project duration months')), $"{ThisItem.'Opex Project duration months'} months")

Text(
    DateAdd(
        DateAdd(
            ThisItem.'Start Date',
            (ThisItem.'Opex Project duration years' * 12 + ThisItem.'Opex Project duration months'),
            TimeUnit.Months
        ),
        -1,
        TimeUnit.Days
    ),
    "dd.mm.yy"
)

If(
    And(
        ThisItem.'Use Country Inflation Profile'='Use Country Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
        ThisItem.'Use Inflation Profile'='Use Inflation Profile (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes
    ),
    If(
        gblSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Italy",
        "Italy - " & Substitute(
            gblAreaWithRegion,
            "Italy_",
            ""
        ),
        gblSelectedProject.Country.Name
    ),
    Text(
        ThisItem.'Inflation Profile',
        "###,###,###.0 %"
    )
)

)

Align.Right

If(
    ThisItem.Threshold,
    Switch(
        ThisItem.'Threshold Type',

        "p75",
        Thresholds.'Net Yield p90',
        "p90",
        Text(
            ThisItem.'Threshold individual',
            "###,###.0"
        )
    ),
    Blank()
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost)) || locResetStartDate,
    locCODDate,
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCostParent)),
    DateAdd(
        locSelectedOpexCostNext.'Start Date',
        (locSelectedOpexCostNext.'Opex Project duration years' * 12) + locSelectedOpexCostNext.'Opex Project duration months',
        TimeUnit.Months
    ),
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedDeviceTypeInProject)),
    With(
        {
            varLastRelatedPeriod: Last(
                Sort(
                    Filter(
                        colOpexProjectCosts,
                        DeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject = locSelectedDeviceTypeInProject.DeviceTypesInProject
                    ),
                    'Created On',
                    SortOrder.Ascending
                )
            )
        },
        If(
            IsBlank(varLastRelatedPeriod),
            locCODDate,
            DateAdd(
                varLastRelatedPeriod.'Start Date',
                (varLastRelatedPeriod.'Opex Project duration years' * 12 + locSelectedOpexCostParent.'Opex Project duration months'),
                TimeUnit.Months
            )
        )
    ),
    locCODDate
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Int(locSelectedOpexCost.'% of Revenues') = locSelectedOpexCost.'% of Revenues',
    Text(locSelectedOpexCost.'% of Revenues', "#"),
    Text(locSelectedOpexCost.'% of Revenues', "#0.0#")
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ProcentOfRevenues.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_Opex.IsTwoDecimal(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ProcentOfRevenues.Value))
    ),
    "Enter a number with no more than two decimal places.",
    And(
        IsNumeric(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ProcentOfRevenues.Value),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_Opex.InRange(
                txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ProcentOfRevenues.Value,
                0,
                10000
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Value must be between 0 and {Text(
        10000,
        "#,###.0#"
    )}."
)

    ),
     "Value must be a numeric with two decimal place.",
    And(
        IsNumeric(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMwh.Value),

            fn_Numeric_Opex.InRange(
                txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMwh.Value,
                0,
                1000000000
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Value must be between 0 and {Text(

        "#,###.0#"
    )}."
)

)

)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCostParent)),
        IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost),
        Not(tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile.Checked)
    ),
    Text(
        locSelectedOpexCostParent.'Inflation Profile',
        "0.0"
    ),    
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost)),
        Not(tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile.Checked)
    ),
    Text(
        locSelectedOpexCost.'Inflation Profile',
        "0.0"
    ),
    And(
        gblSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Italy",
        tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile.Checked
    ),
    Text(
        Max(
            LookUp(
                'Country Inflation Profiles',
                And(
                    Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                    Year = Value(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear.Value),
                    Area = drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AreaInflationProfile.Selected.Value
                )
            ).Inflation,
            0
        ),
        "0.0"
    ),
    tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile.Checked,
    Text(
        Max(
            LookUp(
                'Country Inflation Profiles',
                And(
                    Country.Country = gblSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                    Year = Value(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear.Value)
                )
            ).Inflation,
            0
        ),
        "0.0"
    )
)

If(
    tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile.Checked,
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCostParent) && IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost.'Parent Cost')),
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)

    Text(
        locSelectedOpexCost.'Inflation Profile',

    ),
    And(

    ),

    /*

        Not(IsBlank(locSelectedRevenueContract)),

                    Year = Value(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear.Value)
                )
            ).Inflation,
            0

        "0.0"

)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_Opex.IsOneDecimal(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a numeric with 1 decimal place",
    And(
        IsNumeric(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value),
        Not(
            And(
                Value(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value) >= 0,
                Value(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value) <= 100
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and 100."
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value)),
        Not(fn_Percentage_Revenues.IsPercentage(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a number with 1 decimal place",
    And(
        IsNumeric(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value),
        Not(
            And(
                Value(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value) >= 0,
                Value(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value) <= 100
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and 100."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
$"DisplyMode {And(
    Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_FixCosts_ErrorMessage.Visible),
    Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ProcentOfRevenues_ErrorMessage.Visible),
    Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMwh_ErrorMessage.Visible),
    Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerWtg_ErrorMessage.Visible),
    Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMw_ErrorMessage.Visible),
    Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Description.Value))),
    Or(
        Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost)),
        CountRows(
            Filter(
                locSelectedProjectCosts,
                And(
                    Not('Opex Project Cost' = locSelectedOpexCost.'Opex Project Cost'),
                    Description = Trim(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Description.Value)
                )
            )
        ) = 0
    ),
    Not(IsBlank(dte_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_StartDate.SelectedDate)),
    Or(
        Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost)),
        CountRows(
            Filter(
                locSelectedProjectCosts,
                And(
                    Not('Opex Project Cost' = locSelectedOpexCost.'Opex Project Cost'),
                    'Start Date' = dte_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_StartDate.SelectedDate
                )
            )
        ) = 0
    ),
    Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DurationYears.Selected)),
    Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DurationMonths.Selected)),
    Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Currency.Selected)),
    Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Aggregation.Selected)),
    Or(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_FixCosts.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ProcentOfRevenues.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMwh.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMw.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerWtg.Value))
    ),
    Or(
        tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Checked = false,
        And(
            tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Checked = true,
            Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear.Value)),
            Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear_ErrorMessage.Visible),
            Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value))
        )
    )
)}; {Char(10)}
InflationProfile: {tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Checked} => {Or(
    Not(tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Checked),
    And(
        tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Checked,
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear.Value)),
        Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value))
    )
)}"

Rules.InvariantScript:
/*If(
    locSelectedOpexCost.'Align With Project Duration' = 'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.No,
    false,
    locSelectedOpexCost.'Align With Project Duration' = 'Align With Project Duration (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
    true,
    true
)*/
With(
    {
        varExternelContract: If(
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCostParent)),
                IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost)
            ),
            locSelectedOpexCostParent.'External Contract?',
            locSelectedOpexCost.'External Contract?'
        )
    },
    If(
        varExternelContract = 'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.No,
        false,
        varExternelContract = 'External Contract? (Opex Project Costs)'.Yes,
        true,
        locSelectedSubaccount.Order = 1 && gblLeftNavigationSelected.ItemDisplayName = "Other OPEX Costs",
        false,
        true
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_FixCosts_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ProcentOfRevenues_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Threshold_Individual_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMwh_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerWtg_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMw_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Description.Value))),
        Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Description_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Or(
            Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost)),
            CountRows(
                Filter(
                    locSelectedProjectCosts,
                    And(
                        Not('Opex Project Cost' = locSelectedOpexCost.'Opex Project Cost'),
                        Description = Trim(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Description.Value)
                    )
                )
            ) = 0
        ),
        Not(IsBlank(dte_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_StartDate.SelectedDate)),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DurationYears.Selected)),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DurationMonths.Selected)),
        Not(
            And(
                drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DurationYears.Selected.Value = 0,
                drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DurationMonths.Selected.Value = 0
            )
        ),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Currency.Selected)),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Aggregation.Selected)),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_DistributionFrequency_Month.Selected)),
        Or(
            Not(togl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Threshold.Checked),
            Not(IsBlank(rdg_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Threshold.Selected.Value))
        ),
        Or(
            Not(rdg_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Threshold.Selected.Value = Thresholds.Individual),
            Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Threshold_Individual.Value))
        ),
        Or(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_FixCosts.Value)),
            Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ProcentOfRevenues.Value)),
            Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMwh.Value)),
            Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerMw.Value)),
            Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_EuroPerWtg.Value))
        ),
        Or(
            Not(tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Checked),
            And(
                tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Checked,
                Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear.Value)),
                Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear_ErrorMessage.Visible),
                Not(lbl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_ErrorMessage.Visible),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Value))
            )
        ),
        If(
            gblSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Italy" && tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile.Checked && tgl_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CountryInflationProfile.Checked,
            Not(IsBlank(drp_OpexCosts_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AreaInflationProfile.Selected.Value)),
            true
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)
